rules.title: San Francisco ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices using nonpublic competitor data
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use qualifying algorithmic devices that calculate nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy. Tenants may sue for damages, injunctive relief, and civil penalties.
rules.key_value: Up to $1,000 per violation; each month per affected unit may be a separate violation
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlords of residential dwelling units in San Francisco using qualifying algorithmic devices.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only where a landlord uses a qualifying algorithmic device relying on nonpublic competitor information

rules.penalty: Damages, injunctive relief, and civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation; each month of use for each affected unit may be a separate violation (S.F. Admin. Code § 37.10C(b) and (d)).
rules.quoted_span: The ordinance prohibits landlords from using qualifying algorithmic devices that calculate nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy.
rules.conflict_note: Secondary law-firm source; effective date given only as October 2024. Now at issue in Gomez v. Greystar (N.D. Cal.).

rules.title: San Diego prohibition on algorithmic rent-setting using nonpublic competitor data
rules.requirement: Prohibits landlords' use of algorithmic rent-setting devices similar to San Francisco's ban; tenants may sue for damages, injunctive relief and penalties.
rules.key_value: Up to $1,000 per violation; each month and affected rental property may be a separate violation
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlords of rental property in San Diego using covered algorithmic pricing products.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only where a landlord uses a covered algorithmic device

rules.penalty: Tenant suits for damages, injunctive relief and penalties of up to $1,000 per violation (San Diego Mun. Code §§ 98.1103(b) & 98.1104(a)).
rules.quoted_span: San Diego similarly authorizes tenant suits for damages, injunctive relief and penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and affected rental property potentially constituting a separate violation.
rules.conflict_note: Secondary law-firm source; effective date given only as June 2025. Now at issue in Keller v. UDR Inc. (S.D. Cal.).

rules.title: Berkeley prohibition on coordinated pricing algorithms
rules.requirement: Prohibits landlords from using coordinated pricing algorithms to set rents; violations recur per unit per month and tenants have private remedies.
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlords of residential rental units in Berkeley.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only where a landlord uses a coordinated pricing algorithm

rules.quoted_span: Prohibits coordinated pricing algorithms; recurring unit/month violations and private remedies, previously at issue in RealPage, Inc. v. City of Berkeley et al. , (N.D. Cal.) (voluntarily dismissed with prejudice Jan. 14, 2026).
rules.conflict_note: Secondary source; effective date given only as January 2026. RealPage's challenge (RealPage, Inc. v. City of Berkeley) was voluntarily dismissed with prejudice Jan. 14, 2026.

rules.title: Santa Ana ban on anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing
rules.requirement: Prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing by landlords; tenants may bring private claims.
rules.key_value: Up to $1,000 per violation and per month
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlords of rental housing in Santa Ana using automated rent price-fixing tools.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only where a landlord uses specified automated rent price-fixing

rules.penalty: Private tenant claims and up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.quoted_span: Ordinance NS-3090 prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing; private tenant claims and up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.conflict_note: Secondary law-firm source; municipal code section not given.

rules.title: Jersey City ban on algorithmic rent coordination services
rules.requirement: Prohibits landlords from using algorithmic rent coordination services; enforced publicly and privately.
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlords of rental housing in Jersey City.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only where a landlord uses an algorithmic rent coordination service

rules.penalty: Public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits a landlord s use of algorithmic rent coordination services; includes public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.conflict_note: Secondary law-firm source; effective date given only as June 2025.

rules.title: Hoboken ban on software/algorithmic rent coordination
rules.requirement: Prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlords of rental housing in Hoboken.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only where a landlord uses software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents

rules.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.conflict_note: Secondary source cites 'ch. 158-2' (possibly Chapter 158, Article II); effective date given only as July 2025.
